currentCard.prompt: Какие клетки образуют миелиновые оболочки аксонов в центральной нервной системе?

answers.note: Шванновские клетки образуют миелин в периферической, а не центральной нервной системе.
Астроциты поддерживают нейроны, регулируют межклеточную среду и участвуют в гематоэнцефалическом барьере.
Один олигодендроцит своими отростками обеспечивает миелином несколько сегментов аксонов — на одном или разных аксонах.
Микроглия — иммунные фагоцитирующие клетки центральной нервной системы.

currentCard.explanation: В центральной нервной системе миелин образуют олигодендроциты. В периферической нервной системе сходную функцию выполняют шванновские клетки.

source.title: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e: Nervous Tissue

literal.prompt: Какие клетки образуют миелиновые оболочки аксонов в центральной нервной системе?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Table12.2 L73–L78 separates CNS oligodendrocyte myelination from PNS Schwann myelination, astrocyte support and microglial surveillance/phagocytosis. L91 directly names oligodendrocyte as CNS axon-myelin source; L101/L106 repeat PNS versus CNS distinction. All four offered labels are glial cell types, grammatically plural naming answers and comparably detailed. Thus exactly key2 satisfies the full CNS qualification; presence of another myelinating type does not create a second key because its compartment is PNS.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: В центральной нервной системе миелин образуют олигодендроциты. В периферической нервной системе сходную функцию выполняют шванновские клетки.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L91/L106 explicitly put oligodendrocyte myelin in CNS and L101/L106 put Schwann myelin in PNS. Two sentences accurately name the key and the material compartment distinction, without saying all glia or every axon are myelinated.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Шванновские клетки образуют миелин в периферической, а не центральной нервной системе.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L101 explicitly states Schwann cells insulate peripheral axons with myelin, contrasted with oligodendrocytes; L106 summarises CNS versus PNS. Note preserves this normal anatomical compartment distinction and directly teaches the own wrong-option function rather than denying myelination altogether.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Астроциты поддерживают нейроны, регулируют межклеточную среду и участвуют в гематоэнцефалическом барьере.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L82–L83 identify astrocytes supporting CNS neurons, maintaining extracellular chemical concentrations, removing excess signalling molecules and contributing to BBB. Note correctly compresses those own-astrocyte facts and says “участвуют”, not sole formation of BBB.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Один олигодендроцит своими отростками обеспечивает миелином несколько сегментов аксонов — на одном или разных аксонах.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L91 states each oligodendrocyte process reaches an axon and one cell supplies myelin for multiple segments on same or separate axons. L108/L113 reinforce multiple separated segments. Note accurately preserves one cell/many segments and the same-or-different-axon alternatives; it does not confuse axon count with segment count.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Микроглия — иммунные фагоцитирующие клетки центральной нервной системы.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Table12.2 L77 assigns immune surveillance/phagocytosis; L93–L94 describe microglia ingesting/digesting damaged cells/pathogens and call them CNS-resident macrophages. Note states their function/location without adopting the source’s explicitly uncertain developmental-origin hypothesis.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: Какие клетки образуют миелиновые оболочки аксонов в центральной нервной системе?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Шванновские клетки образуют миелин в периферической, а не центральной нервной системе.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: «Какие клетки…? — Шванновские клетки» is a consistent plural naming answer; note’s plural predicate and CNS/PNS contrast are grammatical.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: Schwann cells genuinely form myelin, making this the nearest plausible compartment-confusion distractor rather than an unrelated cell.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: L101/L106 assign them to PNS, whereas the prompt explicitly asks CNS and L91 assigns CNS myelin to oligodendrocytes. Thus Schwann is wrong under the complete question, with no second myelinating CNS key.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: The note positively teaches this option’s actual peripheral-myelination role, explicitly supportedL101/L106; “а не центральной” applies the relevant normal compartment distinction.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: Какие клетки образуют миелиновые оболочки аксонов в центральной нервной системе?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Астроциты поддерживают нейроны, регулируют межклеточную среду и участвуют в гематоэнцефалическом барьере.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: «Астроциты» is a plural cell-type label matching the prompt, and the three coordinated functions in its note are grammatically sound.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: Astrocytes are real CNS glia near oligodendrocytes; confusing neuronal support/BBB functions with myelin support is credible.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: Table12.2 differentiates astrocyte support from oligodendrocyte insulation; L82–L85 list astrocyte roles and L91 directly identifies the myelinating CNS type. Astrocytes are not the requested myelin-forming cells.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: Note teaches three concrete own-astrocyte functions: support, extracellular milieu and BBB contribution, allL82–L84. It neither claims exclusive BBB formation nor attributes oligodendrocyte segment myelination to astrocytes.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: Какие клетки образуют миелиновые оболочки аксонов в центральной нервной системе?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Один олигодендроцит своими отростками обеспечивает миелином несколько сегментов аксонов — на одном или разных аксонах.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: «Олигодендроциты» is a grammatical plural naming answer, with no case/length cue; note explicitly distinguishes one cell from multiple axon segments.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: The true specific CNS glial type must be distinguished from its PNS myelinating counterpart and two other CNS glia; all labels are genuine members of the same category.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: L91 directly names CNS axonal insulation by oligodendrocytes, and Table12.2/L106 contrast the other types/compartments. Exactly key2 meets the CNS qualifier.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: Own-option extra fact is how one cell’s processes supply several axon segments, either on same or different axons (L91/L108/L113). This goes beyond just knowing it forms CNS myelin and is absent from prompt/key and existing explanation.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: Какие клетки образуют миелиновые оболочки аксонов в центральной нервной системе?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Микроглия — иммунные фагоцитирующие клетки центральной нервной системы.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: «Микроглия» is an established collective glial-type label usable as a standalone answer to «какие клетки»; its note supplies plural phagocytic-cell description consistently.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: Microglia are real CNS glia, making this a plausible neighbouring-type confusion.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: Table12.2L77 and L93–L94 identify immune/phagocytic function, distinct from oligodendrocyte myelin atL91. They do not meet the requested myelin-forming role.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: Note positively teaches immune phagocytosis and CNS localisation atL77/L93–L94. It avoids making a categorical origin claim where the source says research is not conclusive.

absoluteLevel.individualGround: The item requires specific nervous-tissue/glial-cell classification: CNS oligodendrocytes versus PNS Schwann cells, while distinguishing other CNS support and immune glia. General knowledge that axons carry signals does not answer it. Cell-type and compartment knowledge allows meaningful elimination rather than four arbitrary names; this is specific histological knowledge supporting HARD without an obscure treatment protocol or arbitrary numeric fact.

correctNoteExtraFact.fact: One oligodendrocyte’s processes provide myelin for several axon segments on the same or different axons.
correctNoteExtraFact.beyondPromptAndKey: Prompt/key only identify which CNS cells form sheaths. They do not give the one-cell/multiple-segment organisation or same/different-axon alternatives, which are explicitL91 and reinforcedL108/L113.
